alerts.title: Prescribed Fire Operations are Underway near Beaver Meadows Visitor Center
alerts.description: Ignition operations have begun west of Beaver Meadows Visitor Center, along U.S. Highway 36. U.S. Highway 36 in Rocky Mountain National Park is open. There could be smoke on the road from fire operations. Motorists traveling along U.S. Highway 36 should travel with caution. Be prepared for one-lane traffic led by a pilot vehicle between Beaver Meadows Visitor Center and Beaver Meadows Entrance.

alerts.title: Trail Ridge Road Status Update
alerts.description: Trail Ridge Road is closed to through travel. The road is closed at Many Parks Curve on the east side of the park and at Colorado River Trailhead on the west side. For the latest information on the status of Trail Ridge Road, call 970-586-1222.
